name: where_in_ticking
description: where_in and where_not_in while the left table, the set table or both tick: keys that arrive in the set, a duplicate of a key, a key that loses one of its rows and then its last, a key replaced by another in one cycle, null, NaN and signed zero keys, a set that empties and fills again, left rows that change their key, a static left table, an append-only left table, a set made from the left table so that both change in one cycle, Boolean with byte, no match columns, and refusals against a ticking set. The updates of some results are recorded as well.
